description.en: Atypical sexual interests causing distress or harm
description.hi: कष्ट या हानि उत्पन्न करने वाली असामान्य यौन रुचियाँ

mappingNote: ICD-11 paraphilic disorders are 6D30-6D36 plus 6D3Z; there are no separately named MMS categories for fetishistic disorder, transvestic disorder or sexual masochism disorder - consider 6D36 only when its requirements are met (index 17.1.2).
